utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Call the case, please, Madam Registrar.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honours. This is case number IT-98-34-T, the Prosecutor versus Naletilic and Martinovic.

utterances.speaker: MR. KRSNIK
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honours. Your Honours, I wish to inform you about certain events that occurred yesterday, and I was quite astonished by them, I have to say. After the end of the hearing yesterday, I met the Defence counsel, Mr. Pisarevic in the defence room, whose client is on the same floor as my client in the detention unit, and he tells me that Mr. -- He asked me how Mr. Naletilic is, and I said, "Well, he probably wasn't feeling too well so that's why he wasn't -- that's why he wasn't here." And then he said, "Do not you know that he was taken straight to the surgery after the hearing two days ago?" And I said, "I have no idea." And I didn't have any idea until this very day when I called the detention unit. And my client, I got in touch with him today, because the day before yesterday, he was taken straight to the hospital from this courtroom and at 8.00 p.m., a coronography. It's a very serious and very dangerous surgical procedure. Nobody informed his Defence counsel. The Madam Registrar also learned yesterday what was going on. Nobody saw fit to inform the Defence counsel. And after such a surgery, if you given a person in such a state a piece of paper, a waiver of his right to attend trial -- I mean. He didn't have the opportunity to consult me. I didn't have any idea what was going on. This is an international Tribunal, Your Honours. Can we go into private session, please, Your Honours?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Yes, we will go to the private session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
